output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the mintedAmount parameter, which is added to the balanceOf target without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of any user to any value, leading to potential loss of funds.

The mintToken function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The mintedAmount is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the owner to mint unlimited tokens to any user account, causing a severe issue.
